title_zh: 人本城市验收图谱：六类使用者、场景空间与停止条件
title_en: Human City Acceptance Atlas: Six Users, Spatial Scenarios, and Stop Conditions
purpose_zh: 把既有六类用户画像、十条代表性场景路径、十七张场景卡、临时空间锚点与三段发布门压缩到一张审阅图中；图谱只重解已有资料，不新增现实服务、人员、许可、绩效或空间结论。
purpose_en: Condenses existing six-persona records, ten representative scenario paths, all seventeen scenario cards, provisional spatial anchors, and three release gates into one review figure. It only resolves existing records and adds no real service, staffing, permit, performance, or spatial conclusion.

scope.scope_note_zh: 六条人物路径只选择与该画像直接关联的代表性场景；十七张场景卡仍以完整清单显示，未被选作单独人物路径的场景不因此失效或被省略。

limits_zh: 图中空间点位只来自提交包的临时 geometry/constraints.geojson，用于概念阅读和引用核验；不表示实际服务点、道路线位、值守人员、运营状态、容量、许可、保险、工程可行性或社会结果。所有缺少实测的数据继续保持 unknown。
limits_en: Spatial points come only from the package's provisional geometry/constraints.geojson for conceptual reading and reference checks. They do not represent actual service points, alignments, staffing, operating status, capacity, permits, insurance, engineering feasibility, or social outcomes. All unmeasured data remain unknown.
